ValidationRule.description: National Id, Employee Id, Badge Code and Name/Email are validated with REGEX, VALUE, REVERSE, ASCII, CHR, MOD, LPAD-style, INITCAP and SUBSTITUTE forensics.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(National_Id__c)), IF( REGEX(National_Id__c, '[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}'), OR( LEFT(National_Id__c, 3) = '000', LEFT(National_Id__c, 3) = '666', VALUE(LEFT(National_Id__c, 1)) = 9, MID(National_Id__c, 5, 2) = '00', RIGHT(National_Id__c, 4) = '0000', AND(LEFT(National_Id__c, 3) = REVERSE(LEFT(National_Id__c, 3)), MID(National_Id__c, 5, 2) = REVERSE(MID(National_Id__c, 5, 2))) ), TRUE ) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Employee_Id__c)), OR( NOT(REGEX(Employee_Id__c, 'E[0-9]{6}')), AND(REGEX(Employee_Id__c, 'E[0-9]{6}'), MOD(VALUE(RIGHT(Employee_Id__c, 6)), 97) = 0, NOT(Is_Remote__c)) ) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Badge_Code__c)), OR( Badge_Code__c <> UPPER(Badge_Code__c), NOT(REGEX(Badge_Code__c, '[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{5,11}')), LEFT(Badge_Code__c, 1) = RIGHT(Badge_Code__c, 1), MOD(ASCII(LEFT(Badge_Code__c, 1)) + ASCII(RIGHT(Badge_Code__c, 1)), 13) = 0, LEN(SUBSTITUTE(Badge_Code__c, CHR(48), '')) < LEN(Badge_Code__c) - 3 ) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Work_Email__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(First_Name__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Last_Name__c)), OR( NOT(BEGINS(Work_Email__c, LOWER(LEFT(First_Name__c, 1) & SUBSTITUTE(Last_Name__c, ' ', '')))), Name <> INITCAP(LOWER(First_Name__c & ' ' & Last_Name__c)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Employee identity fields (national id, employee id, badge, name/email) are malformed.
